description.value: Sushi Bar Shu is an intimate omakase sushi bar on Granville Street, founded in 2018 by Chef Hyunki Shin, who draws on 18 years of culinary experience including training in Japan. The restaurant offers curated multi-course tasting menus built around seasonal Japanese ingredients, served at a sushi bar in a refined, guided dining setting. Reservations are required well in advance and the experience is designed as a deliberate, unhurried culinary journey.

No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or any cycling-specific amenities; the restaurant is explicitly reservation-only with no walk-ins accepted.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists 604 428 1868 — recommend updating OSM.
Reservation-only policy with no walk-ins accepted; strict 3-day cancellation policy limits utility for unplanned cyclist stops.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant explicitly does not accept walk-ins and requires reservations made at least 3 days in advance, making it impractical as a spontaneous touring cyclist stop. It may still be relevant for cyclists on planned multi-day itineraries, but no cycling-friendly amenities could be confirmed.
